XML_RULE: XML TOOL TRANSPORT: The native model template uses XML for tool calls. Put each opening parameter tag on its own line, put the exact argument value on the next line, and put the closing parameter tag on its own following line. Never append a structural closing tag to a string argument value. Preserve the complete supplied tool schemas, literal argument values and ordinary tool semantics. This is serialization guidance only; perform all requested actual tool work and tests.
EVIDENCE_RULE:
JSON BOOLEAN TRANSPORT: For a tool parameter whose schema type is boolean, emit lowercase JSON true or false. Python True/False are invalid for this XML transport. Follow the supplied parameter types exactly. This guidance never coerces or repairs a tool call.

LITERAL SUPPORT BEFORE PUBLICATION: Before writing any high/medium core claim, select substantive actual delivered passages from BOTH of its cited source handles. Include evidence_quotes entries for that claim_index from each source using exact issued read_id and a literal fragment copied inside one delivered excerpt. If support spans excerpts, supply multiple literal fragments. A heading, title, table of contents, cross-reference or search snippet is not a supporting fragment. Write only an atomic claim whose every clause those two actual sources establish. Do not add a familiar fact that is absent from either delivery. Narrow your next read to short literal words from the needed substantive passage if support is missing, or choose another actually fetched source. The root supplies no facts, source choices or quotations.

Keep each selected deep_read_id substantive. Do not count a heading-only response as a deep read. Evaluate actual negative passages for a meaningful limitation. Reconcile issued bindings and observed counters, then publish your own document with those evidence_quotes. Quotes remain subject to the unchanged original literal-and-cited-source validator; they do not automatically establish semantic support. All original source, negation, semantic, blind10, fullSKO, installation and tree gates remain.
